# Archfrican · GRUB boot menu — rendered by theme-switch from the ADL palette (only the COLOURS change per
# theme; upright Inter .pf2 fonts are generated by modules/40-theming.sh). Matches the SDDM login + Plymouth
# unlock: solid graphite ${BG} with ${ACCENT} on the selected entry, aligned on a single clean editorial
# column (30%–70%). Fully tokenised, no image assets — a malformed theme simply falls back to GRUB text mode.

title-text: ""
desktop-color: "${BG}"

# brand header — aligned to the exact same left column as the boot menu and progress bar
+ label {
    left  = 30%
    top   = 22%
    width = 40%
    align = "left"
    color = "${FG}"
    font  = "Inter Bold 28"
    text  = "Archfrican"
}

# boot entries — flat colour selection, generous row height and breathing room
+ boot_menu {
    left   = 30%
    top    = 34%
    width  = 40%
    height = 38%

    item_font           = "Inter Regular 18"
    selected_item_font  = "Inter Regular 18"
    item_color          = "${FG_DIM}"
    selected_item_color = "${ACCENT}"

    item_height     = 42
    item_padding    = 8
    item_spacing    = 8
    icon_width      = 0
    icon_height     = 0
    item_icon_space = 0
    scrollbar       = false
}

# countdown + slim accent progress bar on the same column
+ label {
    id    = "__timeout_label__"
    left  = 30%
    top   = 77%
    width = 40%
    align = "left"
    color = "${FG_DIM}"
    font  = "Inter Regular 14"
    text  = "Arrancando en %d s"
}

+ progress_bar {
    id           = "__timeout__"
    left         = 30%
    top          = 82%
    width        = 40%
    height       = 3
    fg_color     = "${ACCENT}"
    bg_color     = "${BG_DIM}"
    border_color = "${BG_DIM}"
}
